```yaml
name: Check for Renamed Group References

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      - '.github/**'
      - 'CODEOWNERS'
      - '**/package.json'
      - '**/tsconfig.json'
      - '**/*.yml'
      - '**/*.yaml'
      - '**/*.json'
      - '**/*.ts'
      - '**/*.tsx'
      - '**/*.js'
      - '**/*.jsx'

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  check-renamed-group:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Check for kibana/cloud-security-posture references
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Search for old group name
        id: search
        run: |
          # Define the old group name
          OLD_GROUP="kibana/cloud-security-posture"
          
          # Find files containing the old group name, excluding binary files and node_modules
          # We focus on config files, workflows, and code as per the request
          FILES_WITH_OLD_GROUP=$(grep -r --include="*.yml" --include="*.yaml" --include="*.json" --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.js" --include="*.jsx" --include="CODEOWNERS" --include="*.md" --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=build --exclude-dir=dist "$OLD_GROUP" . 2>/dev/null || true)
          
          if [ -n "$FILES_WITH_OLD_GROUP" ]; then
            echo "found=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "files<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "$FILES_WITH_OLD_GROUP" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "found=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Comment on PR if old group name found
        if: steps.search.outputs.found == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const files = `${{ steps.search.outputs.files }}`.trim().split('\n').filter(line => line.length > 0);
            
            // Format the list of files for the comment
            const fileList = files.map(file => {
              // Extract just the file path from the grep output (format: ./path/to/file:content)
              const filePath = file.split(':')[0];
              return `- \`${filePath}\``;
            }).join('\n');

            const commentBody = `## ⚠️ Renamed Group Reference Detected

            We have renamed the GitHub group from \`kibana/cloud-security-posture\` to \`kibana/contextual-security\`.
            
            The following files still contain references to the old group name:

            ${fileList}

            Please update these references to use the new group name \`kibana/contextual-security\`.
            
            > Note: Textual mentions in comments/docs are not urgent but can be updated in a follow-up pass.
            `;

            await github.rest.issues.createComment({
              issue_number: context.issue.number,
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              body: commentBody
            });
```
